queries.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT 'before' AS period, DATE '2024-01-29' AS s, DATE '2024-03-01' AS e UNION ALL SELECT 'after', DATE '2024-04-22', DATE '2024-07-01') SELECT w.period AS period, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.purchase_order t WHERE CAST(t.order_date AS DATE) >= w.s AND CAST(t.order_date AS DATE) < w.e) AS DOUBLE) / date_diff('day', w.s, w.e) AS value FROM w

WITH w AS (SELECT 'before' AS period, DATE '2024-01-29' AS s, DATE '2024-03-01' AS e UNION ALL SELECT 'after', DATE '2024-04-22', DATE '2024-07-01') SELECT w.period AS period, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.purchase_order t WHERE CAST(t.order_date AS DATE) >= w.s AND CAST(t.order_date AS DATE) < w.e AND CAST(t.is_late AS INTEGER) = 1) AS DOUBLE) / date_diff('day', w.s, w.e) AS value FROM w

WITH w AS (SELECT 'before' AS period, DATE '2024-01-29' AS s, DATE '2024-03-01' AS e UNION ALL SELECT 'after', DATE '2024-04-22', DATE '2024-07-01') SELECT w.period AS period, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN t.value <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM w JOIN main.stock_snapshot t ON CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= w.s AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) < w.e GROUP BY w.period
